definitions.explanation: A dark-colored vinegar made from rice or grains, known for its mellow flavor and health benefits. Chinese black vinegar and Japanese kurozu are popular varieties.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}のために{毎朝|まいあさ}{黒酢|くろず}を{飲|の}んでいる。
examples.english: I drink black vinegar every morning for my health.

examples.japanese: {黒酢|くろず}をかけた{酢豚|すぶた}は{美味|おい}しい。
examples.english: Sweet and sour pork with black vinegar is delicious.

examples.japanese: {鹿児島|かごしま}の{黒酢|くろず}は{全国的|ぜんこくてき}に{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Black vinegar from Kagoshima is famous nationwide.

notes:
TYPES:
・{中国|ちゅうごく}{黒酢|くろず} - Chinese black vinegar (Chinkiang/Zhenjiang vinegar)
・{鹿児島|かごしま}{黒酢|くろず} - Kagoshima black vinegar (Japan)
・{玄米|げんまい}{黒酢|くろず} - brown rice black vinegar

HEALTH BENEFITS:
Black vinegar is popular as a health drink in Japan. It's believed to help with fatigue, blood pressure, and metabolism.

CULINARY USES:
・{酢豚|すぶた} - sweet and sour pork
・{酢|す}の{物|もの} - vinegared dishes
・ドリンク - diluted as a health drink
・ドレッシング - salad dressings
